⚠️ PHISHING ALERT: Fraudulent Emails Targeting State Vendors — Scammers are impersonating Louisiana state employees using fraudulent email addresses ending in @la-gov.us instead of the legitimate @la.gov. These emails falsely claim vendors owe fees for noncompliance with digitization standards.

Do not click links, open attachments, or submit payments.

If you have already made a payment, contact your bank immediately. Verify suspicious emails directly with your established state agency contact using known contact information.

Apply online for licensure as a Private Radiological Technologist through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Radiological Technologist (Private) License Renewal

Renew your Private Radiological Technologist license online through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Radiological Technologist (Private) License Verification

Find Private Radiological Technologists licensed through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Real Estate Agent License Verification

Find Real Estate Agent licensed through the Real Estate Commission.

Real Estate Broker License Verification

Find Real Estate Brokerage Firm/Company licensed through the Real Estate Commission.

REAL ID Checklist

Find out if you have everything you need to get a Louisiana REAL ID using an interactive checklist.

Register to Vote

Register to vote or change voter registration online via the Secretary of State's website.

Report an Incident or Complaint to DEQ

Citizens can file environmental complaints, incident reports (spill/incident release) or criminal investigation complaints with the Department of Environmental Quality.

Report Child Abuse/Neglect

Provides instructions for reporting non-emergency information related to child abuse and/or neglect via the Department of Children and Family Services

Report Medicaid Welfare Fraud

File a report if you have reason to believe someone is defrauding the Medicaid welfare program or abusing a recipient.

Reporting Fraud

Submit a complaint to the Department of Children & Family Services if you suspect a recipient is abusing public assistance (Food Stamps, Child Care, or Cash Assistance, etc.), or if you suspect a retailer is purchasing Food Stamp benefits.

Repossession Agent License Verification

Find Repossession Agents licensed through the Office of Financial Institutions.

Request to Cancel Plates

Cancel your license plates online at the Office of Motor Vehicles.

Resale Certificates

Resale Certificates are issued to wholesalers approved through the Louisiana Department of Revenue to not collect state sales taxes on items purchased for resale. Resale certificates can be validated and printed online.

Respiratory Therapist License Application

Apply online for licensure as a Respiratory Therapist through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Respiratory Therapist License Renewal

Renew your Respiratory Therapist license online through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Respiratory Therapist License Verification

Find Respiratory Therapists licensed through the State Board of Medical Examiners.

Safe Haven Directory

Use the Department of Children & Family Services portal to find the nearest Safe Haven site to relinquish custody of newborns up to 60 days old without the threat of prosecution for neglect, abandonment or child cruelty.

Salvage Yard Auto Hulk

Salvage yards can report when a vehicle is crushed using this tool from the Office of Motor Vehicles.

Sanitarian License Renewal

Renew your Sanitarian license online through the State Board of Examiners for Sanitarians.

Search Attorney General Opinions

Search for released opinions of the Attorney General.

Search for Louisiana Business Filings

Search for business entities (i.e., corporations, limited liability companies, limited liability partnerships, non-profit corporations, trade names, trademarks, or service marks), including information on officers, address, filing date and other basic contact information.

Second Injury Fund Payments

Online payment portal to pay into the Second Injury Fund through the Louisiana Workforce Commission.

Secretary of State Museums

Experience Louisiana's Old State Capitol, as well has nine other smaller, culturally diverse museums dotting Louisiana's landscape.

Seed Programs Online Payment Services

Renew payment for seed programs with the Department of Agriculture & Forestry.

Senate: Broadcast Archive

Access archival broadcast footage of the Louisiana Senate hearings and meetings dating from 2008.

Sign up for My DOTD

Use My DOTD to stay connected with the Department of Transportation and Development including up-to-date information on local projects, lane and road statuses and other DOTD activity.

Social Worker License Application

Apply online for licensure as a Registered Social Worker, Certified Social Worker or Licensed Clinical Social Worker through the State Board of Social Work Examiners.

Social Worker License Renewal

Renew your Registered Social Worker, Certified Social Worker or Licensed Clinical Social Worker license online through the State Board of Social Work Examiners.

Social Worker License Verification

Find Registered Social Workers, Certified Social Workers or Licensed Clinical Social Workers licensed through the State Board of Social Work Examiners.

SONRIS

The Louisiana Department of Conservation and Energy's SONRIS (Strategic Online Natural Resources Information System) tool provides data access (e.g., oil and gas information, coastal information), document access (e.g., Office of Conservation oil/gas production cards and field orders, Office of Mineral Resources lease records), GIS access (e.g., interactive mapping) and more.

Specialized Plate Request

Submit requests for special license plates online at the Office of Motor Vehicles.

Speech-Language Pathologist Complaint

File a complaint online against an Speech-Language Pathologist.

Speech-Language Pathologist License Application

Apply online for licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist through the Board of Examiners for Speech Pathology & Audiology.

Speech-Language Pathologist License Renewal

Renew your Speech-Language Pathologist license online through the Board of Examiners for Speech Pathology & Audiology.

Speech-Language Pathologist License Verification

Find Speech-Language Pathologists licensed through the Board of Examiners for Speech Pathology & Audiology.

State Government Jobs

Louisiana Jobs is an interactive recruiting site designed to help job seekers connect their passion with the mission of Louisiana State agencies. The website includes a job events calendar, mission-driven and agency specific job searches, and featured jobs.

State Library- Ask A librarian

Use the Ask A Librarian form allows users to submit reference questions to the State Library.

State Library- Search Catalog

Search the catalog of the State Library of Louisiana

State Museum-Rental Inquiry Form

The Louisiana State Museum provides the ability to rent several locations for events. Use this application form to begin the process of hosting your special event at a museum location.

State Parks Reservations

Book a cabin at one of Louisiana's 21 state parks using Culture, Recreation & Tourism's online reservation system.

Supreme Court E-Filing

Louisiana Supreme Court E-Filing allows counsel to electronically file documents with the Louisiana Supreme Court.

Supreme Court Live Stream

Live streaming of oral arguments when the Louisiana Supreme Court is in session.

Surplus Property Auctions

Access online government-surplus auctions, and see items for sale at the monthly live auction, through the Louisiana Property Assistance Agency.

Tax Refund Status

Check on the status of your individual income tax refund through the Department of Revenue's website.

Teacher Authorization Verification

Find Teacher authorizations issued through the Department of Education.

Tow/Storage Facility Junk Car Database

Tow/Storage facilities can request permission to dispose of a junk vehicle using this tool from the Office of Motor Vehicles.

Training Registration

Review and sign up for training opportunities offered by the State Fire Marshal's Office

Transportation Bid Letting

Online bidding can be submitted by businesses to the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development through Bid Express.

Unemployment Claim / HIRE

Start or re-open an unemployment claim online as well as file for weekly benefits through the Louisiana Workforce Commission. Individuals are also provided assistance finding a job, creating a resume and finding training opportunities.

Utility Purchase Gas Adjustments or Fuel Adjustments

Search for adjustments made to gas or fuel utility prices within the Public Service Commission's database.

Vehicle Registration Renewal

Renew your Louisiana vehicle registration online through the Office of Motor Vehicles.

Vehicle Statement of Non-Use

Cancel the liability insurance on a vehicle that you own and will not be using on any roads or highways. Your vehicle record will immediately be updated to indicate that the vehicle will not be used on the date range indicated.

Veterans Cemeteries

Veterans Affairs operates four Veterans Cemeteries located across the state, offering a variety of burial options for veterans, spouses and dependent children. Complete the online Internment Application for consideration.

Veterans Homes

Apply online for nursing home care through Louisiana’s five state-of-the-art Veterans Homes across the state.

Veterinarian / Technician License Verification

Find Veterinarians and Veterinarian Technicians licensed through the Board of Veterinary Medicine.

Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor License Verification

Find Vocational Rehabilitation Counselors licensed through the Professional Vocational Rehabilitation Counselors Board of Examiners.

Weights & Measures Online Payment Services

Renew payment for weights and measures with the Department of Agriculture & Forestry.

Workers' Compensation Payments

Online payment portal to pay workers’ compensation assessment fees through the Louisiana Workforce Commission.

Workers' Compensation Records Request

Submit an online request for Workers' Compensation records.

511 Traveler System and Traffic Cameras

511 is Louisiana's official, easy-to-remember traveler information service. 511 provides continual updates about weather-related road conditions, road work, commercial vehicle restrictions, road closures, live video feeds from traffic cameras and other travel information.
